articles.title: Trump, Xi & Putin Hold ‘Groundbreaking’ China Summit
articles.description: President Xi Jinping warned that major-power rivalry breeds global instability and called for regular exchanges between China, Russia and the US while hosting what he called a “groundbreaking” trilateral meeting. Sitting at a round table in Shenzhen, China, the leaders of the world’s biggest nuclear powers spoke about the need to prevent atomic war and resolve conflicts around the globe, including in Ukraine and Iran. Anthropic shares are indicated to open higher in gray market trading after the artificial intelligence lab’s upsized $107 billion initial public offering and private placement broke SpaceX’s record. Today’s guests: Simon Dangoor, Goldman Sachs Asset Management Deputy Chief Investment Officer for Fixed Income & Head of Fixed Income Macro Strategies; Nick Candy, Candy Capital CEO & Reform UK Treasurer; Bronek Masojada, Lord Mayor of the City of London (Source: Bloomberg)
